Asset type: Hearts of Iron IV scripted-GUI animated front-marker source frame, Event 033 Acid Rain

Constraints: genuine transparent background with real alpha from the initial generation; keep unused corners fully transparent; preserve one stable circular silhouette suitable as frame 000 of an animation.
